summary: Roblox fan app with a section highlighting available free stuff

existing_features.title: Update `FreeStuffPostCard` to prominently display an availability badge or indicator (e.g., 'Available' in green / 'Unavailable' or 'Expired' in red/gray) based on the `isAvailable` field of each post.
Add an 'Available Only' filter toggle to `FreeStuffFeed` so users can filter the list to show only posts where `isAvailable` is `true`.
Update `FreeStuffCreationForm` to include an 'Available' checkbox/toggle field that sets the initial `isAvailable` value when creating a new free stuff post.

Update `useGetFreeStuffPosts` and `useCreateFreeStuffPost` hooks to pass and receive the `isAvailable` field, and add a new `useUpdateFreeStuffAvailability` mutation hook that calls the backend availability update function.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a section showing available free items/rewards

Add an `isAvailable` boolean field to the free stuff post data model in the backend, defaulting to `true` for newly created posts. Expose a function to toggle or update availability status for a post.
